title: no day but today to post my @The Jonathan Larson Project video as it ...
transcript: Jonathan Larson has always reminded us that the story never ends that even after someone is gone love does not disappear Jonathan passed nearly 30 years ago he left behind hundreds of cassette tapes and scripts and music files aspirational songs for shows he hadn’t written yet and just so much work that had never been finished The Jonathan Larson Project currently playing at the Orpheum Theater brings that work to life it is not only a love letter to Jonathan Larson but honestly it's a love letter from Jonathan Larson to all of us these songs were all written in the 80s and 90s and somehow they feel so relevant like in a lot of ways it really feels like he is writing for today I actually saw a concert version of the Jonathan Larson Project in 2018 at 54 below and while it is still definitely more of a song cycle than a book musical this production is way more staged with costumes and a set I would say there is a bit of a arc the cast is incredible all together as a group but also individually they all have like songs and moments stick out me if you love Rent or tick tick… boom you cannot skip this but even if you are not familiar with him I think there is so much to be gleaned from his work about life and love and the world we live in and it's just so special seeing a Jonathan Larson show in the east Village where rent began it's impossible to quantify what Jonathan Larson musical theater but new music 30 years later is such a gift thank you jonathan
